questions.q: For any commodity to serve effectively as money, it must possess the ability to be broken down into smaller denominations without losing its value. This essential characteristic is known as...
questions.explain: **Divisibility** is the characteristic of money that allows it to be broken down into smaller, standard units (e.g., Naira can be divided into Kobo). This ensures that money can be used to settle transactions of very small values without hassle.
questions.exam: NECO Commerce Part 2: Finance, Marketing, Legal Aspects & Business Management
questions.subject: Commerce

questions.q: The function of money that enables a commercial firm to accurately record its assets, liabilities, and trading profits in a unified ledger is its role as a...
questions.explain: Money acts as a **unit of account** (or measure of value), meaning it provides a standard metric for pricing and valuing all goods and services. Without this function, accounting and maintaining accurate financial records would be practically impossible.
